Electrification and Development: Empirical Evidence on the Effect of Electricity Provision on Household Welfare
abstract: The effect of electrification on economic outcomes is a major new area of study in environment and development economics. Almost a billion people in the world do not have access to grid electricity. Providing them a grid connection will be costly and polluting as well, even if powered by cleaner fossil fuels such as natural gas, instead of coal. However, the economic benefits of electricity are not well understood. Some studies find large effects on economic development in the long run, while others find small or negligible impacts on households in the short run. These benefits may also depend on household characteristics such as credit constraints that prevent them from consuming power or investing in complimentary assets. This paper highlights the state of current knowledge on the costs and benefits of electrification by reviewing the recent empirical literature. We discuss the identification strategies employed and evaluate the effect of electrification on a variety of household-level outcomes such as income, employment and education.
abstract_zh: 电气化对经济结果的影响，是环境与发展经济学中一个新兴的重要研究领域。世界上近十亿人无法接入电网。即使使用天然气等较清洁的化石燃料而非煤炭来供电，为他们接通电网也将成本高昂，并且同样会造成污染。然而，电力所带来的经济效益尚未得到充分理解。一些研究发现，电力对长期经济发展具有很大影响，而另一些研究则发现，其对家庭的短期影响很小或可以忽略不计。这些效益还可能取决于家庭特征，例如阻碍家庭使用电力或投资互补性资产的信贷约束。本文通过回顾近期的实证文献，强调了关于电气化成本与收益的现有知识。我们讨论了所采用的识别策略，并评估了电气化对收入、就业和教育等一系列家庭层面结果的影响。

title: Firm Innovation under Import Competition from Low Wage Countries
Inefficient Water Pricing and Incentives for Conservation
abstract: We use two randomized controlled trials in Bangladesh to study a simple water conservation technology for rice production called “Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD)”. Despite proven results in agronomic trials, our first experiment shows that AWD only saves water and increases profits in villages where farmers pay a marginal price for water, but not when they pay fixed seasonal charges. The second RCT randomly distributed debit cards that can be used to pay volumetric prices for irrigation water. This low-cost, scalable intervention causes farmers to place more value on the water-saving technology. Demand for the technology becomes less price-sensitive.
abstract_zh: 我们利用孟加拉国的两项随机对照试验，研究了一种名为“干湿交替灌溉”（Alternate Wetting and Drying，AWD）的简单水资源节约技术，该技术用于水稻生产。尽管该技术在农艺试验中已被证明有效，但我们的第一项实验表明，AWD只有在农民按边际价格支付水费的村庄才能节约用水并增加利润，而在农民按固定季节性费用缴费的村庄则不然。第二项随机对照试验随机发放了借记卡，农民可以用这些卡支付按用水量计价的灌溉水费。这一低成本且可推广的干预措施，使农民更加重视这项节水技术。对该技术的需求变得对价格不那么敏感。

title: The Effect of Forest Access on the Market for Fuelwood in India
abstract: Fuelwood collection by poor people is often cited as the most important cause of deforestation in developing countries. Using household survey data from India, we show that households located farther away from the forest spend more time in fuelwood collection. These households are likely to sell more fuelwood and buy less. That is, reduced access to forests increases fuelwood collection and sale. This counter-intuitive behavior is triggered by the higher fixed costs of households living farther from the forest arising from larger travel times. By combining two different datasets, we can quantify net fuelwood sales out of a village. We show that a fifth of the fuelwood collected is consumed outside of rural areas, in nearby towns and cities. Our estimates suggest that fuelwood burning may account for roughly 14-20% of the typical daily P M2.5 load in a city like Delhi.
abstract_zh: 贫困人口收集薪柴，常被认为是发展中国家森林砍伐的最主要原因。利用印度的住户调查数据，我们发现，距离森林较远的家庭在收集薪柴上花费的时间更多。这些家庭更可能出售更多薪柴，购买更少。也就是说，森林可达性降低，反而增加了薪柴的收集和出售。这种反直觉的行为，是由于距离森林较远的家庭因较长的出行时间而产生的较高固定成本所引发的。通过结合两个不同的数据集，我们能够量化从村庄流出的薪柴净销售量。我们发现，收集的薪柴中有五分之一在农村地区以外被消费，即在附近的城镇和城市中被消费。我们的估计表明，在德里这类城市中，薪柴燃烧可能占典型日均PM2.5负荷的约14%至20%。

Does the Quality of Electricity Matter? Evidence from Rural India
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: This paper estimates the returns to household income due to improved access to electricity in rural India. We examine the effect of connecting a household to the grid and the quality of electricity, defined as hours of daily supply. The analysis is based on two rounds of a representative panel of more than 10,000 households. We use the district-level density of transmission cables as instrument for the electrification status of the household. We find that a grid connection increases non-agricultural incomes of rural households by about 9 percent during the study period (1994-2005). However, a grid connection and a higher quality of electricity (in terms of fewer outages and more hours per day) increases non-agricultural incomes by about 28.6 percent in the same period.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了印度农村地区改善电力可及性所带来的家庭收入回报。我们考察了将家庭接入电网的效果，以及电力质量（以每日供电小时数定义）的影响。分析基于一个具有全国代表性的、超过10,000户家庭的两轮面板数据。我们使用地区层面的输电线路密度作为家庭通电状况的工具变量。我们发现，接入电网使农村家庭的非农收入在研究期间（1994至2005年）增加了约9%。然而，接入电网以及更高的电力质量（即停电更少、每日供电时间更长），使同一时期的非农收入增加了约28.6%。

title: Global Impacts of the Biofuel Mandate under a Carbon Tax
abstract: Many countries are actively promoting biofuel mandates as a means of reducing carbon emissions and dependence on imported oil. In the United States, the Federal Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) calls for the minimum use of 15 billion gallons per year of corn ethanol by 2015.Beyond 2015, the mandate calls for a steady increase in the use of second generation biofuels to a level of 21 billion gallons in 2022.The EU biofuels mandate requires the share of biofuels to rise from the current share of 4% to 10% in 2020.An important goal of these energy mandates is to reduce GHG emissions. However, many studies suggest that biofuel policies do not induce significant reductions in emissions. Chen, Huang, and Khanna (2012) develop a model of the US food and fuel sectors and conclude that the impact of the mandate alone in reducing GHG emissions is small, but increases when the mandate is accompanied by a subsidy for second generation biofuels or a carbon tax. Other studies find that the biofuel mandate can cause an increase in direct GHG emissions (de Gorter and Just 2009).By lowering the price of the blending fuel, the mandate when combined with a tax credit results in an increase in fuel consumption, which can raise GHG emissions. Lasco and Khanna (2010) develop a partial equilibrium model of the US fuel sector and show that a combined subsidy and tariff increases ethanol demand and domestic production in the US.GHG emissions increase compared to the no-intervention case. title: Politique pro-carburant et climatique americaine: impact sur les choix energetiques et bilan carbone
State Tax Policy and Oil Production: The Role of the Severance Tax and Credits for Drilling Expenses
venue: Book chapter in U.S. Energy Tax Policy
abstract: Introduction Although most energy-producing states have levied taxes on the value of oil, natural gas, and coal production for many years, changes in these taxes have become headline news as state governments grapple with budget shortfalls brought about by the current recession. For instance, Alaska has increased the severance tax on the value of its oil production and attempted to stimulate future production by allowing a credit against this tax for expenditures on capital items, including drilling rigs, infrastructure, exploration, and facility expansion (Alaska Department of Revenue 2008). In late 2008, California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger proposed levying a 9.9 percent production tax on the value of most onshore oil production to help close a projected $24 billion budget deficit, but he subsequently reversed his position (Casselman 2009; Skelton 2009). The Pennsylvania legislature is considering a proposal to levy a 5 percent tax on the value of natural gas produced from the giant Marcellus shale deposit, but the bill is opposed by industry leaders who contend that it would result in 30 percent less drilling as well as revenue reductions to state and local governments totaling $880 million over the next decade (George 2009). These measures, both enacted and proposed, raise a number of long-standing and important questions about the effects of state energy taxes that go well beyond their potential to provide a solid revenue base to support public services.
abstract_zh: 引言：尽管大多数能源生产州多年来一直对石油、天然气和煤炭的生产价值征收税费，但随着各州政府在当前经济衰退带来的预算短缺中艰难应对，这些税收的变化已成为头条新闻。例如，阿拉斯加提高了其石油生产价值的开采税（severance tax），并试图通过允许对包括钻井平台、基础设施、勘探和设施扩建在内的资本性支出抵扣该税，以刺激未来的生产（Alaska Department of Revenue 2008）。2008年底，加利福尼亚州州长阿诺德·施瓦辛格提议对大部分陆上石油生产的价值征收9.9%的生产税，以帮助弥补预计240亿美元的预算赤字，但他随后撤回了该提议（Casselman 2009；Skelton 2009）。宾夕法尼亚州立法机构正在考虑对从巨大的马塞勒斯页岩矿床开采的天然气价值征收5%的税，但该法案遭到了行业领袖的反对，他们认为这将导致钻井活动减少30%，并在未来十年内使州和地方政府的收入减少8.8亿美元（George 2009）。这些已实施和拟议的措施，都引发了一系列长期存在且重要的问题，即州能源税的影响如何，而这些问题远远超出了其作为稳定公共服务收入来源的潜力。

title: Fuel vs Food
abstract: Many countries have actively encouraged the production of biofuels as a low-carbon alternative to the use of fossil fuels in transportation. To what extent do these trends imply a reallocation of scarce land away from food to fuel production? This paper critically reviews the small but growing literature in this area. We find that an increase in biofuel production may have a significant effect on food prices and, in certain parts of the world, in speeding up deforestation through land conversion. However, more research needs to be done to examine the effect of newer generation biofuel technologies that are less land intensive as well as the effect of environmental regulation and trade policies on land-use patterns.
abstract_zh: 许多国家积极鼓励生物燃料的生产，将其作为交通运输中替代化石燃料的低碳选择。这些趋势在多大程度上意味着稀缺土地从粮食生产向燃料生产的重新配置？本文对这一虽小但正在增长的文献进行了批判性回顾。我们发现，生物燃料产量的增加可能对粮食价格产生显著影响，并在世界某些地区通过土地转化加速森林砍伐。然而，关于新一代生物燃料技术（其土地密集度更低）的影响，以及环境监管和贸易政策对土地利用模式的影响，仍需更多研究。

title: Openness, Lobbying and Provision of Infrastructure
Ordering the Extraction of Polluting Nonrenewable Resources
abstract: A well-known theorem by Herfindahl states that the low-cost nonrenewable resource must be exploited first. Consider resources that are differentiated only by their pollution content. For instance, both coal and natural gas are used to generate electricity, yet coal is more polluting. We show that the ordering of extraction need not be driven by whether a resource is clean or dirty. Coal may be used first, followed by natural gas, and again by coal. Such “vacillation” does not occur under cost heterogeneity. A perverse policy implication is that regulating pollution may accelerate use of the polluting resource. (JEL Q32, Q38, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: Herfindahl的一个著名定理指出，应当首先开采成本较低的不可再生资源。考虑仅因污染含量不同而有所区别的资源。例如，煤炭和天然气都用于发电，但煤炭的污染更严重。我们表明，开采的顺序不一定由资源是清洁还是肮脏决定。煤炭可能先被使用，然后是天然气，再之后又是煤炭。这种“摇摆”（vacillation）在成本异质性的情况下不会发生。一个反常的政策含义是，对污染进行监管可能会加速对污染性资源的使用。（JEL Q32, Q38, Q53, Q58）

title: Environmental Effects of Intensification of Agriculture
A Hotelling Model with a Ceiling on the Stock of Pollution
venue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
abstract: Environmental agreements such as the Kyoto Protocol aim to stabilize the amount of carbon in the atmosphere, which is mainly caused by the burning of nonrenewable resources such as coal. We characterize the solution to the textbook Hotelling model when there is a ceiling on the stock of emissions. We consider both increasing and decreasing demand for energy. We show that when the ceiling is binding, both the low-cost nonrenewable resource and the high-cost renewable resource may be used jointly. A key implication is that if energy demand were to decline in the long run, we may supplement energy supply through "clean" renewables to meet the environmental standard, but then revert back to using only "dirty" fossil fuels in the future when the ceiling has become non-binding. That is, the much heralded societal "transition" to clean energy resources may be somewhat short-lived.
abstract_zh: 《京都议定书》等环境协定旨在稳定大气中的碳含量，而大气中的碳主要来源于煤炭等不可再生资源的燃烧。我们刻画了在排放存量存在上限时，教科书式Hotelling模型的解。我们同时考虑了能源需求递增和递减两种情形。我们表明，当上限具有约束力时，低成本的不可再生资源和高成本的可再生资源可能被联合使用。一个关键含义是，如果能源需求在长期内下降，我们可以通过“清洁”的可再生能源来补充能源供给，以满足环境标准；但当上限不再具有约束力时，未来又会恢复仅使用“肮脏”的化石燃料。也就是说，人们盛赞的社会向清洁能源资源的“转型”，可能只是暂时的。

title: Discontinuous Extraction of a Nonrenewable Resource
Efficiency and Technical Change in the Philippine Rice Sector during the Post-Green Revolution Era
abstract: We estimated the regional Farrell measure of technical efficiency and the Malmquist total factor productivity index of the Philippine rice sector. Using the one-output four-input model for the period during 1971-1990, the results showed that the total factor productivity was only slightly positive during this period. Luzon Island experienced strong positive growth of total factor productivity as well as the technological change during the post-Green Revolution era in the late 70s when the second generation modern varieties were introduced. Although the change in inefficiency was quite small, the inefficient production continued in some regions such as Central and Eastern Visayas. The negative growth in the late 80s suggests that the growth of the output could not catch up with the growth of input levels.JEL classification: O13, O33, Q16
abstract_zh: 我们估计了菲律宾水稻部门的区域Farrell技术效率指标以及Malmquist全要素生产率指数。使用1971至1990年期间的单产出四投入模型，结果显示，在此期间全要素生产率仅略有正增长。吕宋岛在20世纪70年代后期第二代现代品种引入的绿色革命后时期，经历了全要素生产率和技术进步的强劲正增长。尽管无效率的变化相当小，但在某些地区，如中部和东部米沙鄢群岛，仍存在低效生产的情况。20世纪80年代末的负增长表明，产出的增长未能跟上投入水平的增长。JEL分类：O13, O33, Q16

title: Basinwide Water Management: A Spatial Model
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper develops a spatial model for a water basin that allows for surface water allocation and re-use of the water that is lost. The analytical solution suggests specialisation of production over space - upstream farmers use canal water and downstream farmers pump groundwater that is lost upstream. Groundwater emerges as an endogenous "backstop". The empirical results suggest that when traditional conservation technologies are used, optimisation over the entire basin leads to significant increases in aggregate output, project area and water use. Somewhat counter-intuitively, rents from water decrease if farmers switch from traditional to modern irrigation technology.
abstract_zh: 本文为一个流域构建了一个空间模型，该模型允许地表水分配，并允许对流失的水进行再利用。解析解表明，生产在空间上存在专业化分工：上游农民使用渠道水，而下游农民抽取地下水，这些地下水来自上游的渗漏。地下水作为一种内生的“后备资源”出现。实证结果表明，在使用传统节水技术的情况下，对整个流域进行优化，将显著提高总产出、项目区面积和用水量。与直觉相反的是，如果农民从传统灌溉技术转向现代灌溉技术，水资源的租金反而会下降。

title: Protecting Forests Through Farming: A Dynamic Model of Nontimber Forest Extraction
Modeling the Effects of Area Closure and Tax Policies: A Spatial-Temporal Model of the Hawaii Longline Fishery
abstract: We develop an economic model for a multi-species fishery that incorporates the spatial and temporal distribution of effort and fish stocks. Catchability coefficients and initial stocks are estimated from catch and effort data for each specific location. Vessels are allocated over space and time to locations of maximum profit, which decline with harvest because of stock externalities. A supply function for labor allocation in the fishery is estimated. The simulated model is applied to the Hawaii longline fishery. The economic impacts of regulatory policies, such as reduction of inshore gear conflict and conservation of offshore turtle populations, are examined.
abstract_zh: 我们为一个多物种渔业构建了一个经济模型，该模型纳入了捕捞努力量和鱼类资源的空间与时间分布。捕获系数和初始资源量是根据每个具体地点的捕获量和捕捞努力数据估计的。渔船在空间和时间上被分配到利润最大的地点，而这些地点的利润会因存量外部性而随着捕捞量的增加而下降。本文估计了渔业中劳动力配置的供给函数。该模拟模型应用于夏威夷延绳钓渔业。文中考察了诸如减少近岸渔具冲突、保护远洋海龟种群等监管政策的经济影响。

title: Domestic Energy Demand in OPEC Countries
Water Conveyance Costs and Conjunctive Use
abstract: Suggests a spatial conjunctive use model of an irrigation project in which the utility invest optimally for the water distribution system and charge farmers the shadow price of surface and groundwater. Seepage from the irrigation canal and on the field are assumed to recharge the groundwater aquifer. Particular attention was given to the effects of conveyance on the allocation of both surface and groundwater resources and the distribution of rents. An empirical model indicated that higher conveyance costs skew the distribution of water as well as rents over the project area. This suggests that the tail farmers need to face a substantially higher price for water if the system deteriorates and conveyance costs increase in the long run.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个灌溉项目的空间地表水与地下水联合利用模型，在该模型中，项目管理机构最优地投资于配水系统，并按地表水和地下水的影子价格向农民收费。灌溉渠和田间的渗漏补给地下含水层。研究特别关注输水成本对地表水和地下水资源配置以及租金分配的影响。实证模型表明，较高的输水成本会使水资源分配以及项目区内的租金分配发生偏斜。这表明，如果系统老化、输水成本在长期内上升，末端农民将不得不面对高得多的水价。

title: Demand for Ground Transportation Fuel and Pricing Policy in Asian Tigers: A Comparative Study of Korea and Taiwan
abstract: This paper examines the demand for gasoline and diesel in the ground transportation sectors of South Korea and Taiwan, comparing the effects of their different pricing policies and stages of economic growth. To account for substitutability between the two fuels, the model proposed here uses a system of equations estimated simultaneously with time-series data from 1973-1992. Results yield demand elasticities that confirm previous research showing that oil product demand is generally price inelastic, while income elasticities (reflecting a longer period of economic growth than previous studies in the Asian region) are lower than those previously reported. The estimated demand functions are then used to generate forecasts for both countries and, in particular, for an assumed reduction in a 180% tax on gasoline in Korea. Forecasted increases in demand by the year 2010 range from 40 to 180%, while the tax analysis suggests that Korea's pricing policy has reduced total demand and promoted the use of diesel over gasoline.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了韩国和台湾地面交通部门对汽油和柴油的需求，比较了两地不同定价政策和经济增长阶段的影响。为考虑两种燃料之间的替代性，本文提出的模型使用1973至1992年的时间序列数据，对一个方程组进行了联合估计。结果得出的需求弹性证实了先前的研究，即石油产品需求通常缺乏价格弹性，而收入弹性（反映了比以往亚洲地区研究更长的经济增长期）则低于先前报告的水平。随后，估计的需求函数被用于生成两国的预测，特别是针对韩国将汽油税从180%下调的假设情景。预测显示，到2010年需求将增长40%至180%，而税收分析表明，韩国的定价政策减少了总需求，并促使人们更多地使用柴油而非汽油。

title: Transition from Fossil Fuels to Renewable Energy: Evidence from a Dynamic Simulation Model with Endogenous Resource Substitution
abstract: This paper applies an economic model of climate change that is based on endogenous substitution of energy resources to determine the effect of advances in renewable technology on aggregate and sectoral fossil fuel use and energy prices. It uses a Nordhaus type partial equilibrium model of the energy sector with four demand sectors - electricity, transportation, residential and industrial energy and three of the commercially most important exhaustible resources - oil, coal and natural gas. The findings suggest that among the major commercial fuels, oil and natural gas use are not very sensitive to changes in the cost of solar energy, while coal use is expected to reduce drastically as solar becomes more economical. These results suggest that research and development in renewable energy may play only a limited role in the short run, while creating the basis for a transition to a sustainable energy economy over the longer time horizon.
abstract_zh: 本文应用了一个基于能源资源内生替代的气候变化经济模型，以确定可再生技术进步对总体及分部门化石燃料使用和能源价格的影响。该文采用了一个诺德豪斯（Nordhaus）式的能源部门局部均衡模型，包括四个需求部门——电力、交通、居民和工业能源，以及三种商业上最重要的可耗竭资源——石油、煤炭和天然气。研究结果表明，在主要商业燃料中，石油和天然气的使用对太阳能成本变化并不十分敏感，而随着太阳能变得更具经济性，煤炭的使用预计将大幅减少。这些结果表明，可再生能源的研发在短期内可能只发挥有限作用，但从长期来看，将为向可持续能源经济转型奠定基础。

title: Water Conveyance, Return Flows and Technology Choice
abstract: This paper develops a spatial conjunctive use model of an irrigation project in which the regulatory agency determines investments in the centralized distribution system and farmers decide the level of on‐farm technology in the field. Irrigation return flows are assumed to recharge the groundwater aquifer. It is shown that there is specialization in production with upstream farmers using surface water and downstream farmers pumping from the aquifer. An empirical model suggests that the proportion of return flows has a significant effect on the level of investments in water distribution as well as in the field. For example, if return flows are relatively high, it may be optimal to allow for significant water losses from the canal and the fields. It suggests that the project pricing and technology adoption policies may need to be tempered by consideration of the basinwide impacts of water diversions.
abstract_zh: 本文为一个灌溉项目构建了一个空间联合利用模型，在该模型中，监管机构决定对集中式配水系统的投资，农民则决定田间的农场技术水平。灌溉回归水补给地下含水层。研究表明，生产存在专业化分工：上游农民使用地表水，而下游农民则从含水层中抽水。实证模型表明，回归水的比例对配水系统投资以及田间投资水平具有显著影响。例如，若回归水比例较高，那么允许渠道和田间存在大量水量损失可能是最优的。这表明，项目定价和技术采用政策可能需要考虑水资源引水对整个流域的影响，从而加以调整。

title: Endogenous Substitution of Energy Resources and Global Warming
Estimating Economic Impacts from Tourism: A Comparison of Computable General Equilibrium and Input-Output Techniques
A Spatial Model of Optimal Water Conveyance
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Most water projects suffer from losses in conveyance. Because conveyance has public good characteristics, investment in reducing conveyance losses must be provided by a central authority. This paper develops a spatial model to determine optimal conveyance investment, water allocation, and investment in firm-specific conservation technology. The efficiency and distributional characteristics of the optimal solution are compared to projects with (i) well-developed water markets and (ii) spatially uniform water prices, both with sub-optimal conveyance. A numerical illustration is provided, © 1995 Academic Press, Inc.
abstract_zh: 大多数水利工程都存在输水损失。由于输水具有公共产品的特征，减少输水损失的投资必须由中央机构提供。本文构建了一个空间模型，以确定最优输水投资、水资源分配以及对企业特定节水技术的投资。研究将最优解的效率和分配特征，与以下两种情形进行了比较：（i）水市场发达的情形；（ii）水价在空间上统一，且输水不够优化的情形。文中给出了一个数值算例。© 1995 Academic Press, Inc.

title: Efficient Spatial Allocation of Irrigation Water
abstract: In the presence of conveyance losses, the efficient quantity of water applied falls with distance from the water source, but the amount of water "sent" (including conveyance losses) actually increases with distance from the source, except toward the tail end of the irrigation system. This implies that if marginal cost pricing were implemented, farmers at the middle and lower reaches of the system would have to pay more money for less water received. The model is illustrated and alternative financing schemes compared for an empirically derived demand function for irrigation water.
abstract_zh: 在存在输水损失的情况下，有效的灌溉用水量随着距水源距离的增加而减少，但“输送出去的”水量（包括输水损失）实际上随着距水源距离的增加而增加，灌溉系统末端除外。这意味着，如果实施边际成本定价，灌溉系统中游和下游的农民将不得不为收到的较少水量支付更多的费用。本文对该模型进行了说明，并针对一个由经验推导得出的灌溉用水需求函数，比较了不同的融资方案。
